title: Annual Leave Policy
text: Employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave.

title: Vacation Entitlement
text: Workers receive twenty days of vacation every year.

title: Health Benefits
text: The company provides health insurance to full-time employees.

title: Leave Submission
text: Employees must submit leave requests through the HR portal.

title: Holiday Schedule
text: The office is closed on national holidays.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.

title: Information Security & Passwords
text: All staff must use multi-factor authentication (MFA) and change passwords every 90 days.

title: Expense Reimbursement
text: Business travel expenses must be submitted within 30 days accompanied by itemized receipts.

title: Equipment & Laptops
text: Company-issued laptops are encrypted and monitored for unauthorized software installations.

title: Parental Leave
text: New parents receive 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave following birth or adoption.
